claim: The backup plan options page says cold storage is currently available for AWS CloudFormation, DynamoDB with advanced features, Amazon EBS (using EBS Snapshot Archive), Amazon EFS, SAP HANA databases on Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Timestream and VMware virtual machines; the feature availability by resource table also marks lifecycle to cold storage for Amazon Aurora DSQL.

evidence.quote: Cold storage is currently available for the following resource types:

evidence.table_header: | Resource type | Incremental or Full backup in cold storage |

evidence.quote: | DynamoDB with advanced features | Full; no Incremental backups in any tier |
evidence.table_header: | Resource type | Incremental or Full backup in cold storage |

evidence.quote: | Amazon EBS (using EBS Snapshot Archive) | Full; Incremental backups will become Full after transition. |
evidence.table_header: | Resource type | Incremental or Full backup in cold storage |
| Resource type | Incremental or Full backup in cold storage |

evidence.quote: | SAP HANA databases running on Amazon EC2 instances | Incremental |
